work.summary: Digital photobook in MAXQ's Secret B series featuring Korean model and influencer Shin Saerom (신새롬). RIDI's series page links the exact titled product; Aladin's e-book catalog identifies the edition as a 2022-03 PDF by MAXQ International. Electronic Times identifies Shin among the model-influencer participants in its 2022 Fitthy coverage. Page count and ISBN were not verified. No cover image or PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.
